decisions.reason: The digital anamnesis and consent app is promoted as a new product line with its own page, and it fits the dental practice software core and the digitalization trend in German practices.
A continuing education institute for dental professionals strengthens customer loyalty and builds on existing training activities, so it is cheap to maintain and strategically useful.
A remote screen sharing support tool is a low-cost, essential part of the firm's customer support infrastructure for practice software users.
